blocks.content: Remote control: The compressor will react to commands from external switches. Emergency stop remains active. Compressor start/stop commands via Clock function are still possible.

On compressors with an Elektronikon Graphic controller, bridge terminals 1 and 2 of connector (X109) (= DIO6 on the controller). In this mode, the outlet pressure is still sensed by pressure transducer (PT20), resulting in loading and unloading of the compressor at the pressures programmed in the Elektronikon regulator. If terminals 1 and 2 of connector (X109) are not bridged, the compressor is switched out of automatic load/unload operation and remains running unloaded.
Connect a start/programmed stop button (S1') between terminals 1 and 2 of connector (X108)(=DIO3 on the controller).

blocks.content: Compressors with an Elektronikon Graphic controller can also be wired to load and unload depending from the status of a pressure switch:

blocks.section: For remote loading/unloading (via external pressure switch):
blocks.content: Bridge terminals 1 and 3 of connector (X1 08a) (=DIO5 on the controller) and connect a load/unload (pressure) switch (S4') between terminals 1 and 2 of connector strip (X109) (= DIO6 on the controller). This results in loading and unloading of the compressor at the closing and opening pressures of the external pressure switch respectively.
